Bash(git commit -m "$\(cat <<''EOF''
fix: add keyboard shortcuts \(n/a/s\) to sort menu

Changes:
- Add keyboard shortcut handling to sort menu
- Press ''n'' to sort by Name
- Press ''a'' to sort by Age  
- Press ''s'' to sort by Status
- Press ''q'' or ESC to close menu
- Arrow keys still work for selection

Previous behavior:
- Only arrow keys worked in sort menu
- Had to navigate and press Enter

New behavior:
- Press ''m'' to open menu
- Press ''n'', ''a'', or ''s'' directly to sort
- Instant sort without extra navigation

Modified files:
- internal/view/table.go: Added SetInputCapture with keyboard handlers

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
\)")

Bash(git commit -m "$\(cat <<''EOF''
feat: improve keybindings and remove incomplete asUser delete

- Change refresh from ctrl+r to ''r'' for pods/deployments \(harmless operation\)
- Change restart from ''r'' to shift+r for pods/deployments \(deliberate action\)
- Change aliases from ctrl+a to shift+a \(frees up ctrl+a for future use\)
- Merge "Sort Selected Column" into sort menu as option ''o''
- Remove shift+o keybinding \(now available for other purposes\)
- Remove incomplete asUserDeleteCmd from browser, workload, and xray
- Remove ctrl+k "Delete AsUser" keybinding from all views

This simplifies the keybinding model and prepares for a better
impersonation toggle feature on ctrl+a in the future.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
\)")

Bash(git commit -m "$\(cat <<''EOF''
feat: add native backup and restore shortcuts for deployments

- Added ''b'' key to backup deployments to YAML files
- Added ''u'' key to restore deployments from backup menu
- Backups stored in screenDumpDir/deployment-backups/
- Restore shows menu of 5 most recent backups with timestamps
- Direct selection via number keys \(0-4\)
- Replaces bash plugin implementation with native Go code

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
\)")

Bash(git commit -m "$\(cat <<''EOF''
fix: expand tilde in screenDumpDir path for backup/restore

- Added tilde expansion in GetScreenDumpDir\(\) method
- Prevents creation of literal ''~'' directory
- Ensures backups are saved to correct home directory location

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
\)")
